newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate with most trade coming late in the day in the Panhandle area Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to mostly $1.00 per cwt lower.
Confirmed - 10,000 Last week - 42,500 Year Ago - None
WK to date - 94,600 Last week - 73,400 Year Ago - 21,900
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs

Slaughter Heifers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs mostly 61.00 few early 62.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 60.00- 60.50. Utility and Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs including heiferettes 59.00-60.00.
Feedlots reporting moderate to good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 6,900 slaughter steers and 3,100 heifers; 94,600 head confirmed for week to date which includes 25,600 formulated and 100 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
